versions.content: Configuration variants Different use cases require different kinds of configurability. Therefore, the following configuration variants are provided:  VARIANT - PRE - COMPILE: Allows individual configuration parameters to be realized at "Pre - compile time" only.  VARIANT - LINK - TIME: All ows individual configuration parameters to be realized at either "Pre - compile time" or "Link time" .  VARIANT - POST - BUILD: Allows individual configuration parameters to be realized at either "Pre - compile time", "Link time" or "Post - build time" .
